title: targets-ipv6-eui64
author: Daniel Miller
description: This script runs in the pre-scanning phase to convert 48-bit MAC addresses to EUI-64 IPv6 addresses, which are often used for auto-configuration. Generated addresses may be added to the scan queue. The MAC addresses used as input are read from the file named by the targets-ipv6-eui64.input script-arg. A good source of these addresses would be an IPv4 host discovery Nmap scan.
